speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.fresh.1: Gods, you're covered in blood. What happened?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.fresh.2: Don't come near me like that!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.fresh.4: Fetch the healer, someone's been cut up.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.fresh.5: You'll scare the children walking about like that.
Good fight? Smells like a good fight.
Still wet. Who'd you open up?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.dried.0: You've a crust of old blood on you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.dried.1: Haven't you washed since the fighting?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.dried.2: That's blood on you, isn't it? Dried black.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.dried.3: Wash that off before you sit at anyone's table.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.dried.4: Folk will talk, you walking round like a butcher.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.dried.5: A hot tub and a hard brush, that's what you need.
Old blood. You should get yourself some new.
Keep it on. Shows you've done something.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.rotten.1: The flies have found you. Gods, the smell!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.rotten.2: You smell like a week-old carcass.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.rotten.3: Get away! I'll lose my supper.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.rotten.4: Plain water won't shift that. Scrub it off, for pity's sake.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.rotten.5: Something died on you, and it's still dying.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blood.rotten.green: Even I can smell that, and I eat grubs.
Rotten meat on you. Saving it for later?
Phwoar. Now that is a stink.
